verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents AI-driven transformation features: VLM partitioning, generative OCR, table-to-HTML, image descriptions, named entities and schema-based extraction. These are data-preparation outputs, not in-product insights or suggestions about the user's data. The "discover hidden insights" line is a marketing claim about connectors and describes no feature that generates insights or recommendations, so the support is adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
